name: api-development
description: Implement approved FastAPI backend features and bug fixes; use for endpoints, schemas, services and persistence changes.
---

# API development

1. Read the approved plan, acceptance criteria and existing application patterns.
2. Implement only required changes across routes, schemas, services and persistence as appropriate. Handle validation and error paths.
3. Preserve existing contracts unless an approved requirement changes them. Use the configured environment and dependencies.
4. Run relevant configured lint, formatting and focused test checks. Investigate failures within the repository retry policy.
5. Return changed files, requirement coverage, actual check results and unresolved issues. Hand off to Tester; do not commit or create a PR without approval.
